_comment: Documented divergences of the Go engine against the reference pipeline corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). Systematic root cause: the Go on_block hook payload carries short internal reasons plus a violation category in trigger_info, while the reference hook carries the log-format reason with an empty trigger_info, and the passive-mode rate-limit hook reports status_code 0 instead of null. One construction-time divergence: wildcard CORS origins with credentials are rejected by config validation here, while the reference accepts them at construction and blocks CORS at response time (the runtime outcome matches). Status, body, header and flag outcomes all match on every case.
